intro: Allegiance to the Old Gods is a Horde quest tasking adventurers with eliminating Lorgus Jett within the depths of Blackfathom Deeps. Directed by the Darkspear seer Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, the mission aims to disrupt the Twilight's Hammer cultists who seek to awaken ancient forces of destruction. Striking down Lorgus deals a direct blow to the cult's subversive operations beneath Ashenvale's coast.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This Twilight's Hammer follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. The Twilight's Hammer do not understand the spirits of nature. They believe in the Old Gods—creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. You must stop him, friend. I cannot do it myself—I am too weak.
Go into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. Return to me here at Zoram'gar when it's done.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found him yet, friend? Lorgus must be stopped!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good!! Thank you, friend. We may not have stopped the Twilight's Hammer completely, but at least you have staved off another of their plans to return the Old Gods to power.
Who knows what other plans they have manifesting, but we can rest easy for now.
